description: This header defines the AudioPolicyEffects class, which manages audio effects attached to input and output streams within the Android AudioPolicyService. It includes methods for querying, adding, and removing effects, as well as internal classes for effect descriptions, device effects, and effect vectors. The file handles configuration parsing and effect management based on various audio configurations and effects factory interfaces.

classes.name: AudioPolicyEffects
classes.description: Manages audio effects for input and output streams, including configuration parsing, effect descriptors, and device effects.

classes.name: AudioPolicyEffects::EffectDesc
classes.description: Stores description and parameters of an audio effect as defined in configuration.

classes.name: AudioPolicyEffects::EffectDescVector
classes.description: Holds a vector of EffectDesc pointers.

classes.name: AudioPolicyEffects::EffectVector
classes.description: Represents a collection of effects associated with an audio session, with enable/disable functionality.

classes.name: AudioPolicyEffects::DeviceEffects
classes.description: Stores effects associated with a specific device port, including device type and address.

methods.name: AudioPolicyEffects::queryDefaultInputEffects
methods.description: Retrieves default input effects for a given audio session.

methods.name: AudioPolicyEffects::addInputEffects
methods.description: Adds input effects based on input handle, source, and session.

methods.name: AudioPolicyEffects::releaseInputEffects
methods.description: Releases input effects for a given input handle and session.

methods.name: AudioPolicyEffects::queryDefaultOutputSessionEffects
methods.description: Retrieves default output effects for a given audio session.

methods.name: AudioPolicyEffects::addOutputSessionEffects
methods.description: Adds output effects for a specific output handle, stream type, and session.

methods.name: AudioPolicyEffects::releaseOutputSessionEffects
methods.description: Releases output effects for a specific output handle, stream type, and session.

methods.name: AudioPolicyEffects::addSourceDefaultEffect
methods.description: Adds a default effect for a specific audio source.

methods.name: AudioPolicyEffects::addStreamDefaultEffect
methods.description: Adds a default effect for a specific audio usage stream.

methods.name: AudioPolicyEffects::removeSourceDefaultEffect
methods.description: Removes a default source effect by ID.

methods.name: AudioPolicyEffects::removeStreamDefaultEffect
methods.description: Removes a default stream effect by ID.

methods.name: AudioPolicyEffects::initDefaultDeviceEffects
methods.description: Initializes default device effects.

methods.name: AudioPolicyEffects::loadAudioEffectConfigLegacy
methods.description: Loads legacy audio effect configuration from a file path.

methods.name: AudioPolicyEffects::loadAudioEffectConfig
methods.description: Loads audio effect configuration using EffectsFactoryHalInterface.

methods.name: AudioPolicyEffects::loadEffects
methods.description: Parses effect descriptors from configuration tree.

methods.name: AudioPolicyEffects::loadEffect
methods.description: Loads a single effect descriptor from configuration.

methods.name: AudioPolicyEffects::loadInputEffectConfigurations
methods.description: Loads automatic input effect configurations.

methods.name: AudioPolicyEffects::loadStreamEffectConfigurations
methods.description: Loads automatic stream effect configurations.

methods.name: AudioPolicyEffects::loadEffectConfig
methods.description: Loads effect configuration into EffectDescVector.

methods.name: AudioPolicyEffects::loadEffectParameters
methods.description: Loads effect parameters from configuration.

methods.name: AudioPolicyEffects::loadEffectParameter
methods.description: Loads a single effect parameter from configuration.

methods.name: AudioPolicyEffects::readParamValue
methods.description: Reads parameter value from configuration node.

methods.name: AudioPolicyEffects::growParamSize
methods.description: Grows parameter buffer size.

methods.name: AudioPolicyEffects::inputSourceNameToEnum
methods.description: Converts input source name to enum.

methods.name: AudioPolicyEffects::streamNameToEnum
methods.description: Converts stream name to enum.

methods.name: AudioPolicyEffects::setProcessorEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables all effects in an EffectVector.
